title: Dengue deaths reach 481 as 1,960 more are admitted
excerpt: Three deaths were recorded in the 24 hours to 8am on 12 November, in Dhaka, Mymensingh and Rajshahi divisions.
content:
Three people died of dengue and 1,960 were admitted to hospital in the 24 hours to 8am on Thursday, 12 November, according to Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) data reported by The Business Standard and The Daily Star. One death each was recorded in Dhaka, Mymensingh and Rajshahi divisions.

The numbers

  • Deaths this year: 481.
  • Cases this year: 157,628, of whom 151,232 have recovered.
  • In hospital now: 5,915, down from 6,067 a day earlier.
  • Trend: daily admissions over the last four bulletins were 2,260, 1,595, 1,900 and 1,960.

Why it matters

Admissions are holding near 2,000 a day in mid-November, and deaths are now spread beyond Dhaka. NGOs with community health volunteers outside the capital can support early referral for fever, particularly where children may also have measles.
